confirmSibling.message: Same day, same ticker: the day's float, volume and flags are carried over — a DT starts from the open with no premarket, a GUS takes the candidate's premarket. It has its own trades and only counts in its pattern's stats.

confirmAnotherTrade.title: Create another {{ticker}} trade?
confirmAnotherTrade.message: A new empty trade on the same stat: same pattern, its own direction, executions, P&L and post-mortem. The existing trades don't change. Under another pattern, it's another stat: « Same ticker, another pattern ».

derived.label: Filters derived from the prices
derived.OUT_OF_PATTERN_HINT: What the recorded prices say was not the setup — a DT whose retest takes the top back, a GUS outside the sheet's price range. Combines with the tabs.
derived.UNDER_1_DOLLAR_HINT: Open under $1 — derived from the price, no longer a box. Combines with the tabs.

outOfPattern.RETEST_TOOK_TOP: The retest takes the top back : a breakout, not a double top
outOfPattern.PRICE_OUT_OF_RANGE: The open is outside the sheet's price range (~$0.30 – $10)

move.title: Percent move
move.description: How far a price moved, in %, from one price to another — or the reverse: the price a given move leads to.

max.title: Max size
max.description: The largest size the broker will accept on this stock — to place the order once, without it coming back refused.
max.boundByMargin: Bound by the margin: {{shares}} shares at {{perShare}} $/share.
max.boundByCeiling: Bound by your ceiling of {{ceiling}} % of the balance.
max.locatesPaid: Locates are paid whether the trade is taken or not.
max.underLot: Not even one lot: the margin or the ceiling doesn't allow it.

size.title: Position size
size.description: How many shares to short at each entry level above the open, so that a stop never costs more than the risk you chose.
size.aboveStop: The current price is above the stop: the trade is invalidated, no level to take.
size.noLevel: The stop is under the first entry level (+5 %): no level left to short from.
size.tooFar: With this risk, the stop is too far: not even one share.
size.refused: In amber: the margin exceeds the usable buying power ({{usable}} $) — the order would be refused.

rr.title: Distance and R:R
rr.description: Before entering: the distance to the stop and to the target, and what you risk for what you aim at.
rr.stopWrongSide: On a short, the stop goes above the price.
rr.targetWrongSide: On a short, the target goes below the price.
